_about: The reports' own words for a light (the 1879 and 1880 station lists) against Findlay 1879, where tools/match_findlay.py checks finds them different in kind or period; each read on both sources, 28 Oct 2026.
1879 chanonry-point: The 1879 report's slip: its line repeats Covesea Skerries' character (QUIRKS.md); Findlay 1879 and the OCR of the report agree on that reading.
1879 outer-dowsing-lv: Conflict: the report says red, revolving every 90 seconds; Findlay 1879 says every 20 secs. Findlay 1887 gives ½ min with an alteration in 1883, and Edwards (1884) red, revolving ½ min. For 1879 the chart takes Findlay and names the conflict.
1880 st-tudwals: Agree in substance: the report's 'occulting, light of 8 seconds duration, followed by eclipse' of 2 seconds is Findlay's description 'Vis. 8 secs., obscured 2 secs.'; Findlay's character column has no kind word.
1880 st-agnes-scilly: Conflict: the report says revolving every half-minute, Findlay 1879 every minute. To settle from Findlay 1887 and Edwards (1884) in the character-by-year step.
1880 sevenstones-lv: Not a conflict: Findlay 1879 has the old character (two fixed lights); Findlay 1887's year column reads '1841 / 1879', an alteration in 1879, and gives one 3-flash light. The 1880 report has the new light.
